lines.en: : Hear ye, hear ye! Uta-chan hereby calls into order discussion surrounding the latest installment of her favorite contest and yours...
: THE SUPER MEGA ULTIMATE DORM WARS ROUND THREE!!!
: Ahem...
: AND ALSO MAKOTO IS BACK AND ENTHUSIASTICALLY IN CHARGE OF THE FIRST FLOOR AGAIN!!! YEAAAAAH!!!
Something feels off.
The gaps between our bigger events are getting smaller and smaller...and if what I heard from Imani earlier is right, it means-
: Additionally, given the totally not suspicious timing of this event, we’ve decided to combine it with our totally not suspicious annual beach trip as well.
: That’s right, Makoto. And ignoring how totally not suspicious your insistence on things not being suspicious is, it falls on the two of us to assign the competitions and competitors.
It’s not just the Dorm War that’s showing up early...it’s everything.
Well, everything so far. But who’s to say that this year’s competition won’t end with yet another jump to Christmas or Halloween or...whatever the universe wants to throw at us next.
Makoto knows it too...yet she’s jovially pushing forward in complete disregard for how much this throws our lives off.
And as much as I wish I could join her in her carelessness, I can’t. Especially not with Ayane, Maya, and Ami all acting much different than normal lately.
Is it really possible for me to just sit back and enjoy this next movement in my life?
Or is this one more log to stoke the flames of chaos that creep closer to my home every single day?
The season alone is hot enough without the added heat-
And I can only imagine the fires to come if they are not doused immediately.
Godspeed, endless summer.
May the winter come and swallow you whole.
: Now, there is one elephant in the room that needs to be addressed before-
: Where?!
: Miku, come on...
: Show me the elephant, Makoto! Show it to me!
: It’s a...never mind. What I’m trying to say is that there’s still the matter of last year’s winner not receiving any sort of prize as of yet.
: Wait...didn't last year's contest end in a tie?
: Maybe in this timeline. But who's to say there's not a second timeline running alongside this one where that didn't happen?!
: That just sounds like a convenient excuse to not write additional dialogue for a scenario that impacted less than 1%% of the player base.
: The writer is probably exhausted, Kirin! You wouldn't understand!
: Ahem...Uta, could you please take control of the room back now?
: Makoto and I thought long and hard about what to do about this, and we came up with all sorts of options that both did and didn’t involve Sensei.
Oh, maybe I’ll be in luck and not get targeted this year.
: But of course we had to throw away all of the non-Sensei ideas since, let’s face it, we know what 90%% of the class is really after.
Or not.
: The thing is, with the next Dorm Wars just a short while away, we didn’t have time to set up some sort of fun excursion or anything like that as a true reward for last year’s winning floor.

: So instead, we’ve decided to create both a brand new special reward for this year’s winner AND give the winner of last year’s Dorm Wars an extra 2-point handicap coming into this year’s competition.
: Makoto, would you like to tell the class what that brand new special reward is?
: I’d be honored, Uta.
: This year, the winning floor-
: GETS TO HAVE A SLEEPOVER AT SENSEI’S HOUSE! WOOOOOO!
: Why...did you even ask me if I wanted to tell everyone if you were just going to do that?
: Couldn’t help it! Woooooooo!
: Uhh...
: Not excited for the new prize, Senpai?
: Specifically, I’m concerned about how Ami is going to handle this and how they managed to arrange this prize without running it by her.
: We decided it by ourselves last night without talking to Ami! Wooooo!
: LIKE HECK YOU DID! The only person sleeping at my house is me! And also obviously Sensei because it is his house too!
: Oi! I’ve slept at yer’ house on several occasions! What’s the problem this time?
: The...context! I think.
: I don’t know! I’m just mad nobody talked to me about this!
: You know, you don’t look all that excited either. And you seemed to really like this Dorm Wars thing last year.
: Yeah...I did.
: It’s not really that part I’m worried about...
: Then...the beach?
: If you’re worried about being seen in a swimsuit now that it’s actually hot out-
: Let's not do this right now, Senpai. The girls are...trying to do their thing.
: Oh, also, we’re axing the date war this year so nobody winds up getting...well, axed.
: It was for the safety of everyone. We’re sure you all understand.
: Bullshit! The date war is a Dorm Wars tradition and deserves to stay in the competition! We won’t stand for this!
: What are you so upset about? It’s not like you’d be allowed to compete again in the first place. You were already in the first date war thing.
: Shut up, whore. There was no rule about the same person not being allowed to compete twice.
: Actually, in page seven of the Dorm Wars digital handbook in the new Dorm Wars app, you’ll see that there was a rule prohibiting just that.
: Oh. Well, whatever then. It’s not like I actually care or anything.
: Bruh.
: You doin’ okay, Io? Seems like you’re about to catch on fire or somethin’.
: Probably because I am. Why did everyone decide to gather around my desk when I’m the one person who doesn’t want anyone near her?
: Your desk is prime real estate in situations like this. You’re the closest to the center of the classroom.
: Thank you for reminding me to choose a new seat. Shouldn’t be hard since no one here knows how to stay in theirs.
: Apologies for interrupting, but I would like to inquire on whether or not I’d be able to compete in something that does not directly involve our teacher this year.
: Such a thing seems to be even more dangerous today than it was last year, and that is saying quite a lot.
: Excellent question, Touka!
: No.
: N...No? Just like that?
: We have you competing against Ami in a competition to see who can take better care of Sensei.
: Fantastic.
: Do I accept my point now or later? Asking for all of the first floor.
: Hey! Don’t count Touka out just yet! You might not have recognized it since you don’t ever talk to her, but she’s got intense mom-vibes!
: That’s right, Ami. As representative of the first floor, I’ll have you know that Touka is-
: Blah, blah, blah. Easiest competition of my life. Might as well have us compete to see who the best Ami is.
: Why do you seem so down, Touka? I think you’ve got a solid chance at this.
: She’s probably down because she’s competing to see how well she can take care of our fucking weirdo teacher and she’s one of the few who isn’t dead set on humping him to death.
: I would just like one opportunity to show the class that I am more than you all seem to think I am. I have so many talents and never any opportunities to showcase them.
: And last year, I didn’t even get to compete. I just got to stand in a shed and listen to my mother provide sexual education to an adult male.
: You think that’s bad? I got jipped out of 10 G’s and lost a company. Shit’s weak.
: Hey, wait a fuckin’ second! Wasn’t it your bratty sister who bought my idea without-
: Oh, and Yumi and Tsuneyo are also competing to see who can take better care of Sensei!
: Sorry, hold on a sec.
: THE FUCK DID YOU JUST SAY, SHRIMP?!
: To be more specific, you’ll be competing in the first ever two-part Dorm Wars competition!
: And you’ll be stuck with Sensei for the entire weekend!
: Probably even while he sleeps!
: Jeez. Didn’t think I’d ever see an expression like that on you of all people.
: She’ll be fine. She probs just shut her brain off as a form of protection or something. Like that thing kids do when they’re being abused or whatever.
: Damn, Chika. No need to get all dark on us like that.
: When did I give you permission to speak to me?
: I’m back. What happened?
: I’m not really sure. We haven’t gotten the full details yet. But it is presumably something where you need to watch Sensei sleep.
: Huh.
: This is actually kinda cute.
: Please provide further information on how I am meant to slaughter my opponent and obtain the W for the girls back home. Hoo-rah.
: Will do! Take it away, Makoto!
: Are you going to just interrupt me this time as well?
: I would never. Please, proceed. Especially since you’re the one who came up with this competition and I still don’t really get it.
: Essentially, you’ll be working with Noriko in a battle to protect Sensei from being hugged.
: So basically, you’ll be a bodyguard. If you can prevent anyone from getting to him over the course of the Dorm Wars, your team will earn a point.
: But it’ll most likely wind up being two points if Noriko succeeds as the attacker thingy, right?
: Correct, unless the competition ends in a stalemate and neither side has hugged Sensei by the time all of the other contests have ended.
: In that case, both defenders will gain one point and both attackers will gain zero, essentially nullifying both competitions.
: Well, who the fuck is my partner if Noodle-Girl gets to team up with Pinkie? Cause if it ain’t Chika, I ain’t doin’ it.
: The person competing against Noriko as an attacker is...
: Maya.
: Oh, you’ve gotta be fucking kidding me.
: Hah...
: Guess we’re enemies now, huh?
: I guess so.
: The fuck you look all down for? You get to compete in a fucking stupid ass hug-fight or some shit. Ain’t you, like, “in love” with our teacher or whatever? Shouldn’t you be happy?
: I’m not doing it.
: It’s a lot more complicated than that...
: You all know damn well I want nothing to do with Noriko. And that includes wiping the floor with her in some stupid competition. Switch me with someone else.
: No can do, Princess Maya! Your name’s already written down on the thingy! So all that’s left for you to do is fight away the strongest girl in the class and hug the teacher!
: Wait, hold on. Ain’t Ponytail on my team? Why’s she gotta fight away me? Am I not understanding the contest or some shit?
: Aww, how cute. She thinks I was talking about her.
: Yo! Come over here and say that to my face!
: Ah! Makoto, protect me!
: Think you can do it, Maya? You probably don’t have to, like...be around Noriko. You can just be all sneaky and stuff and hug Sensei while no one else is watching.
: You’re good at that, aren’t you?
: I don’t want to compete at all. It’s a stupid idea for a competition and-
: Wait, can you repeat that last part?
: Hm? I just said you should be sneaky or something.
: It should be easy.
: Right...
: Of course, no Dorm Wars would be complete without your team captains competing! So me and Makoto will let ya know what we’re going to be battling in right now!
: Makoto and I.
: And hopefully it ain’t grammar!
: Isn’t.
: Why you always gotta do me like this?
: Habit, I suppose.
: But that’s not important right now!
: Chika Chosokabe! I’m calling you out!
: You and me! The beach! Swimsuits! Maybe a romantic candlelit dinner or something?! Who knows?!
: What Uta means to say is that the two of you will be competing in a gravure-style swimsuit competition judged by Sensei and Miss Imai!
: Hey, that doesn’t sound borderline illegal at all! Great idea, guys!
: Don’t wait until now to get involved again. Let me have this.
: You’re on, Uta! Can’t wait to see what you’ve got in store!
: You can see anything you want, whenever you want! And please forget I just said that!
: As for me, I’ll be competing against Kirin!
: Oooh, nice! In what? Underwear modeling? A tickle fight? Seeing how many marshmallows we can fit in our mouth?
: Better!
: Fishing!
: ...Fishing?
: That’s our super-hype contest?
: Uta and Chika get to wear bathing suits and model for our teachers and I get to fucking fish?
: I’m calling bullshit. Garbage show-runners. It’s the last season of Dexter all over again.
: I’ll trade places with you. That’s the only competition so far that hasn’t sounded like a colossal pain in the ass.
: On another note, Io will be competing against Miku in a contest to see who can build a better raft!
: Never mind. I want the one I actually got instead. You can go back to not existing.
: Hah...
: Mind takin’ it a little easy on me? Building stuff is kinda like, your whole thing, ain’t it?

: I'd say it's a tie between that and self-deprecation. But frankly, I don’t know what sort of nonsense is going on with the competitions this year if we’re handing out matchups as unbalanced as this.
: It would be, like...me competing against you in soccer or something like that.
: Ain’t really doin’ much for my confidence here, Io.
: Sorry, there’s just no way you can win.
: Something horrible would have to happen to me.
: Actually, something horrible will probably happen to me and you’ll probably win. I think I just jinxed myself.
: I’m rooting for you, Miku. I’m sure your raft will be great and I’d love to take a ride on it once it’s done.
: Bet that’s not all you’d like to take a ride on, slut.
: What was that, Io? It’s a little hard to hear you over how absolutely fucking unbearable you are.
: That doesn’t even make sense. But at least the latter part was right.
: It ain’t nice to talk down on others like that, Io. Chika’s good people.
: Thank you, Miku. I knew I could count on you.
: But if you don’t talk down on people, how else are you supposed to feel good about yourself?
: Idunno...do somethin’ you’re good at maybe?
: That...can just make you feel good about yourself? Since when?
: Always for me! Like when I score a sweet goal or beat a personal best time around the track! I always think, “Darn, Miku! You’re pretty awesome!” or somethin’ like that.
: Really gets your blood pumpin’ when you see the...fruits of your improvement or whatever, ya know?
: No.
: Oh.
: Well, never mind then.
: Okay! And now onto...my good pal Molly’s competition! Woohoo! Everybody give a round of applause to Molly!
: Mwahahah! Please, please! You all flatter me! Cease this commotion at once or mine ears shan't hear the challenge being issued!
: No one is clapping.
: No one in this realm. The spirit realm is another story entirely. Oh, if only you could hear it, Kendo Princess.
: My ancestors cry out about the wonderful quest I’ll receive this year! Could Molly MacCormack remain undefeated in the Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars?!
: Of course she can! Because her challenge will be something else she excels in! Such has been the pattern for the rest!
: And with victories in both D&D and video games already under my belt, this challenge must either involve anime, manga, or...something we shouldn’t be speaking about in class!
: I wonder which one it will be.
: In this year's Dorm Wars, Molly and Rin will be having a beach-style cook-off. Whoever makes the best dish wins.
: At last...the time has finally come for me to share my powers with you.
: You have done well thus far, Emerald Guardian. But the world is in my hands now. And my hands are large and resistant to heat from years of being burned in the kitchen.
: I will make you a goddess of the stove before you know it.
: Thanks.
: You and Molly, huh? Is that, like...gonna be weird for you?
: Hm? Not really. I think we’re cool now.
: If anything, the weird part is going to be cooking. My moms always handled that stuff. All I can do is microwave cup-noodles and I doubt that’ll get me anywhere unless Tsuneyo is the judge.
: I can...help teach you some things, Rin. I had to cook for myself a lot when I lived alone.
: I’m not...the best, but...I’m sure I can teach you something.
: Guess that just leaves...the rest of our group, Yasu, and Ayane then. Anyone have any guesses on what the remaining contests will be?
: Hopefully...nothing that...will put me in the spotlight again...
: I’m still a little...worn out from the fashion show...
: Sana, that was like two years ago.
: It takes...a long time for me to...recover...
: Okay, let’s see here...What else do we have, Makoto? Our gals in the back ain’t had much excitement tossed their way just yet.
: No, Uta. It appears they have not. So why not shake things up a bit by announcing a writing contest between Futaba and Nodoka?!
: Well, it’s been nice knowing you all.
: No way, Futaba! I think you’ve got a shot at this! Everything Nodoka writes is really weird and offputting!
: Plus, we don’t even know what the genre is yet. If it’s fantasy, you’ve totally got this. Nodoka sucks at that stuff.

: Also, since writing and the beach are two things that shouldn’t ever really go together since one is fun and the other is kinda lame, we’ve decided to make this writing contest a scary-story contest!
: That’s right! Whoever comes up with the creepiest, most terrifying tale will be crowned the victor.
: Is that good? I can’t tell if that genre is good. You got this? You got this. Maybe? Yeah. You totally do. I think?
: Again, it’s been nice knowing you all.
: I don’t...read very much, but...you can borrow some of my...movies if...it will help you...understand the...genre...
: That’s right! Sana’s totally into all of that stuff! I’m sure she has a ton that will help with Futaba’s journey to become creepier than Nodoka.
: Speaking of Nodoka, you planning on weighing in on this at all back there?
: Hm? Yes. Right. Dorm Wars.
: She’s just...in the zone right now. And thank you, Sana. I can drop by your room later and pick a few things out.
: O...Okay...that sounds...good to me...
: Hey, since only Otoha and Yasu are left from the second floor and Sana’s already gone up against Yasu...that means you two are gonna have to compete right?
: What do you think the contest will be? Something music related? Maybe another test of courage to go along with the scary stuff?
: Who even knows at this point? I’ll be happy so long as it’s nothing embarrassing.
: S...Same here...I don’t...want to spend...another two years...recovering...
: Let’s see, let’s see...notes, notes...ah! Found it!
: Sana and Otoha will be competing to see who can make Sensei’s heart flutter the most with a love confession.
: L...Love?!
: That’s impossible! He doesn’t have a heart! How can we make flutter what does not exist?!
: Thanks, Otoha. Appreciate that.
: Just look at him! Pretending to have feelings! Who does he think he is?!
: Well, damn. Didn’t see that challenge coming.
: Yeah...that sounds...just as dangerous as the date war...doesn’t it?
: What? No. No, no, no. Like, it obviously doesn’t have to be real. It’s just another writing thing.
: Yeah, but the best confessions come from the heart. Which means if you don’t feel anything, you’re at a disadvantage.
: But hey, I only have a 50%% success rate when it comes to confessions, so don’t go looking to me for advice.
: Hahah...guess I’m just pretty screwed then, huh? What with me being so devoted to Rin and everything.
: Aww...girlfriend.
: Are you okay, Sana? You look...very flushed right now.
: Yeah...just...
: Words...
: Hard...
: I agree, Sana. Words hard.
: Words very hard indeed.
: Well, ladies and...Sensei!  And Molly.
: But, before we get to that, we’d also like to let everyone know that the results from Miss Watabe’s poetry contest will be revealed at the beach as well!
: So if you’re one of the people who entered that and are looking forward to whatever weird prize she’s offering for it, stay tuned because you might very well be chosen!
: So, without further ado...
: The last competition for this year’s Dorm Wars will be Ayane vs Yasu!
: But what will they be competing in, Makoto?!
: Great question, Uta! They’ll be competing in-
: The ultimate test of courage! Being dropped off in the middle of nowhere with no resources and having to find their way back!
: Another extremely dangerous and borderline illegal suggestion! Great job again, girls!
: Uta, if you interrupt me one more time, I’m going to break your glasses.
: Ah! As a fellow glasses-girl, I’m shook! You should know better, Makoto!
: Hello.
: Ah?! Wha?! Hah?! Who?!
: Oh...Yasu. It’s just you. You scared me.
: You were scared even before I approached you. I could hear it in your heart.
: You could...what?
: Is something troubling you?
: Uhh...that’s...not really something I have the time to get into right now...
: Because if something is troubling you, I know someone who can help.
: He is a wonderful person. So full of wisdom. With the answers to every question you could ever ask.
: I’m...not really interested in converting or anything...
: I am referring to our teacher.
: You...are? Really?
: Yes. He is a wonderful person. And he finds himself just as lost as you do more often than you’d believe.
: Your hearts match at this very moment. And though it may not seem it, you’re more connected than you’ve ever been before.
: But how long will it last, I wonder?...
: How long will...it last? What do you mean by that?
: I mean...
: Your life is about to become very difficult. And few pass the trials they are handed.
: Will you be one of those few?
: Or will you become more lost than ever before?
: Okaaaaay. You can back up now.
: I’m looking forward to our competition.
: Huh?...Were we...competing in something?
The assignment of the third annual Dorm Wars match-ups comes to a close.
I exit the room with an elevated heart-rate and the fear that this contest will be worse than the last.
I can not tell you why.
And I will not pretend to be excited for it.
